scope: 僅公共斜坡、平台及入口階梯少量補色；建築主體仍中性，保留改裝前後共形近似限制。
original_limitation: 兩層主體近似；參考2024改裝後入口與改裝前官方斜角照片。模型只保留共同可確認的建築量體，不混充某日完整現況；未重建地下停車空間。背面未確認而簡化。
limits: Entire mainbrickface/returns that include palebase on samecontinuous originalfaces; no heighttriangles or allbrick.
All original solidbalcony rails and upperterracebacking, no blackmaterial standin for openrails.
Glazingbacks/mullions with oldpale versus newblue version and reflection/opaque mixtures.
Roofplate/coping/canopy/slab finishes where versions or graystone/blackbeam mixed and not isolated.
rights: No confirmed CC grant. Original source photos private only, no textures or commercial-use guarantee.
source_private_backup: Source originals independently preserved privately; not duplicated in public package.
